BREMEN HARBOR
Bremenhaven, Bremen’s harbor area, appears quiet in the cold air 
of early morning. Dense, icy fog hangs over the port. 
If it is before December 20, go to 451. If it is December 20 
or thereafter, go to 452.
(Bremen Location)
